# Transportation and Extradition

> The Transportation Unit is responsible for the secure custody and transport of sentenced inmates to the Ohio Department of Rehabilitation and Correction, as well as the retrieval and return of wanted fugitives from other jurisdictions. All transportation operations are conducted in accordance with applicable federal and state laws, interagency agreements, and established security procedures to ensure the safety of personnel, inmates, and the public.
>
> The Extradition Unit administers all matters related to the lawful extradition of fugitives to Hamilton County. This unit coordinates with federal, state, and local law enforcement agencies, prosecutors, and judicial authorities to ensure compliance with extradition statutes, court orders, and procedural requirements.
>
> ###### For extradition-related inquiries, contact information is provided below:  **Phone:** 513-946-5359  **Email:** [extradition@hcso.org](mailto:extradition@hcso.org)
